title: One-time evaluation of the frozen final models on the official CICIoMT2024 test files
written: 2026-10-09, before any official test file was read by any code in this project
class_mapping: same six classes as the training subset (Benign 0, DDoS 1, DoS 2, Recon 3, MQTT 4, Spoofing 5); the DoS test file is named TCP_IP-DoS-ICMP (the training file TCP_IP-DoS-ICMP1)
preprocessing: identical column selection to data/processed_grouped/prepare_federated_source.py (same 45 features in feature_names.json order), rows with non-finite values dropped and counted, the saved training scaler data/processed_grouped/scaler.pkl applied (never refit), float32

models.main_confirmation: final checkpoints of Phase 2e (seeds 71-75): MediShield clean/attacked (logs/phase2e_medishield), FedAvg clean/attacked (logs/phase2e_fedavg)
models.comparison: final checkpoints on seeds 63-67: MediShield bsc_6 clean/attacked (logs/table_bsc6_medishield), FedAvg (logs/phase2d_fedavg), Krum, median, trimmed mean (logs/phase2d_baselines), RFA, Fed-ADH (logs/phase2d_baselines2)
models.not_available: oracle runs did not save final models; they are not evaluated

metrics: train_defended.evaluate() unchanged: accuracy, macro precision/recall/F1, per-class recall, IDS FPR, triggered->Benign rate (ASR for attacked runs) with each run's own trigger settings
also_reported: validation value of the same metric (final round) next to the test value
number of official-test feature vectors identical to a training vector (float32 after scaling)
rule: Evaluated once. No model, threshold, setting or reported subset changes after test results are seen; any disagreement with validation is reported as is.
